evidence.note: The genealogy names Abram and Haran as sons of Terah and Lot as Haran’s son.
Lot is named as Abram’s traveling companion and as the owner of flocks, cattle, and tents.

name: לוֹט
summary: Lot is Haran’s son and Abram’s nephew. He traveled with Abram and had flocks, cattle, and tents of his own. The meaning of his name is uncertain.
